notes: Soft gap: the 1,000-instance samples per dataset are not identified, so the exact evaluation set must be re-sampled. Binary-task results for GPT-4-Turbo are mostly in figures (Figure 2) and prose (e.g. 63.7% RED SAM). Table 5 reports variability over five runs on DEPTWEET.

resolution.plan: DepSeverity (3,553 Reddit posts, public per Table 2) was reduced to a 'fair random sample' of 1,000 posts (Sec. 3.3) whose IDs are not published. Draw a seeded uniform sample of 1,000 posts, run the SEV-4 zero-shot prompt (Table 6 base wording) with gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at temperature 0, and compute balanced accuracy and MAE over the four severity levels; compare with 39.6 / 0.805 (Table 10) at the set level.
resolution.approximation: Different 1,000-post sample; the paper's Hoeffding bound puts sampling error within about 5 points.
